questions.question: Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry is associated with which of the following dance style?
questions.solution:
Pasumarthy Ramalinga Sastry is a renowned exponent of Kuchipudi.
  • He is a celebrated dancer and teacher who has contributed significantly to the academic and practical aspects of this Andhra Pradesh-native dance.
  • Kuchipudi is known for its blend of Nritta (pure dance) and Abhinaya (mime), traditionally featuring themes from the Bhagavata Purana.

questions.question: Jawara dance is a popular folk dance of _________ .
questions.solution:
The Jawara dance is a popular harvest folk dance from the Bundelkhand region of Madhya Pradesh.
  • It is performed by both men and women to celebrate a prosperous harvest.
  • The hallmark of this dance is women balancing baskets full of jawar (millet) on their heads while performing vigorous movements.

questions.question: __________ is the first Indian dancer, a transgender, to be honoured with Padma Shri.
questions.solution:
Narthaki Nataraj made history as the first transgender person to be awarded the Padma Shri (2019) in India.
  • She is a distinguished Bharatanatyam dancer specializing in the Thanjavur Nayaki Bhava tradition.
  • Her success is seen as a major milestone for the transgender community in the field of classical arts.

questions.question: Ghoomar dance is associated with which of the following states?
questions.solution:
Ghoomar is the most iconic traditional folk dance of Rajasthan.
  • It was originally performed by the Bhil tribe to worship Goddess Saraswati and was later adopted by other Rajasthani communities.
  • The dance involves women in colorful flowing ghagharas (skirts) performing graceful pirouettes, which create a beautiful swirling effect.

questions.question: Which of the following is the unique dance tradition of Himachal Pradesh?
questions.solution:
Nati is the most famous folk dance of Himachal Pradesh, specifically from regions like Kullu and Shimla.
  • It holds a Guinness World Record for being the largest folk dance in terms of the number of participants.
  • Dancers wear traditional Himachali caps and woolen clothes, moving in a slow, rhythmic circular pattern.

questions.question: Which of these artists is a Manipuri dance style doyenne?
questions.solution:
Rajkumar Singhajit Singh is a leading Manipuri dance maestro and choreographer.
  • He is credited with modernizing Manipuri dance and taking it to international stages through his creative productions.
  • He was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and the Tagore Award for his immense contribution to the art.

questions.question: Which dance form from West Bengal combines elements of classical dance with martial arts, and its movements often depict stories from Indian mythology?
questions.solution:
Chhau is a semi-classical dance with martial, tribal, and folk origins, prominently found in West Bengal (Purulia style).
  • It is characterized by its vibrant masks and energetic movements that depict mythological battles.
  • UNESCO inscribed Chhau in the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

questions.question: T. Balasaraswati is related to which of the following dance?
questions.solution:
T. Balasaraswati was a legendary dancer who made Bharatanatyam famous both in India and abroad.
  • She was a seventh-generation representative of the traditional Devadasi family of musicians and dancers.
  • She was renowned for her mastery of Abhinaya (expressive acting) and her ability to perform complex emotional sequences.

questions.question: Renowned for her Odissi dancing style, ________ is an eminent Indian Classical dancer. She founded the Centre for Indian Classical Dances in New Delhi and was honoured with the Padma Bhushan in 1992.
questions.solution:
Sonal Mansingh is a preeminent Odissi and Bharatanatyam dancer.
  • In 1992, she became the youngest recipient of the Padma Bhushan.
  • She founded the Centre for Indian Classical Dances (CICD) in New Delhi to promote and preserve India's cultural heritage.

questions.question: The Ashtapadis of jayadeva’s Geeta Govinda are sung and danced in which of the following dance form?
questions.solution:
The Ashtapadis (eight-line hymns) of Jayadeva's Geeta Govinda are central to the Manipuri dance form.
  • The Geeta Govinda explores the divine love between Lord Krishna and Radha.
  • In Manipuri dance, these hymns are used to perform the Ras Leela, which is the cornerstone of the dance's devotional aspect.

questions.question: Akham Lakshmi Devi receives the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for her contribution to __________ Dance.
questions.solution:
Akham Lakshmi Devi is an eminent artist who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for her excellence in Manipuri dance.
  • Manipuri dance is known for its Jagoi (gentle) and Cholom (vigorous) movements, distinct from the sharper lines of other classical forms.

questions.question: ___________ is a famous Indian folk dance, which is conducted during the Bihu festival in Assam.
questions.solution:
The Bihu Dance is an energetic folk dance from Assam performed during the Bihu festival.
  • It is a celebration of the changing seasons and the harvest, characterized by brisk steps and rapid hand movements.
  • Dancers wear traditional Muga silk attire and are accompanied by instruments like the Dhol (drum) and Pepa (horn).

questions.question: The legendary Kuchipudi dancer Dr. Raja Reddy referred to one of the following as a ‘Kaliyuga Satyabhama’?
questions.solution:
Sobha Naidu was a legendary Kuchipudi dancer whom Dr. Raja Reddy hailed as a 'Kaliyuga Satyabhama'.
  • She was famous for her portrayal of Satyabhama (the consort of Krishna) in the dance-drama 'Bhamakalapam.'
  • She was a direct disciple of the great master Vempati Chinna Satyam.

questions.question: This legendary Kathak dancer, known for his innovative and modern approach to the dance form, is often referred to as the "Emperor of Kathak." Who is he?
questions.solution:
Pandit Birju Maharaj was the unparalleled master of the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Kathak.
  • He is often called the 'Emperor of Kathak' for his innovative style that blended traditional technicality with modern storytelling.
  • He was also a talented vocalist, composer, and poet.

questions.question: Which dance style does Geeta Mahlik have a reputation for?
questions.solution:
Geeta Mahalik is a distinguished Indian classical dancer recognized for her mastery of Odissi.
  • Her style is known for its lyricism and grace, adhering strictly to the ancient techniques defined in the 'Natya Shastra.'
  • She has been honored with the Padma Shri and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.

questions.question: Jatin Goswami received several awards for his contribution to which dance style?
questions.solution:
Jatin Goswami is a legendary figure who has dedicated his life to the promotion of Sattriya dance.
  • He was instrumental in getting Sattriya recognized as a Classical Dance form by the Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2000.
  • He is a recipient of the Padma Shri and Sangeet Natak Akademi Ratna Sadasya.

questions.question: Which dance style is incorporated with both the Tandava and Lasya?
questions.solution:
Manipuri dance is unique because it beautifully incorporates both Tandava (vigorous/masculine) and Lasya (graceful/feminine) elements.
  • The Ras Leela represents the Lasya aspect, while the Pung Cholom (drum dance) represents the Tandava aspect.
  • This balance makes Manipuri one of the most spiritually deep and visually soft dance forms.

questions.question: Who of the following received Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contribution to Sattriya dance?
questions.solution:
Tankeswar Hazarika Borbayan is a noted artist who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contributions to Sattriya.
  • Sattriya was originally performed by Bhokots (monks) in monasteries (Sattras) as a part of their daily rituals.

questions.question: Which Indian state is known for the traditional dance form of Sattriya?
questions.solution:
Sattriya is the classical dance form of Assam.
  • It was introduced in the 15th century by the great saint-reformer Mahapurush Sankaradeva as a medium for propagating the Vaishnava faith.

questions.question: The Government of Karnataka organizes the ___________ festival every year, which features an scintillating performances of dance, drama and music, is organized amidst the rocks and ruins that date back to hundreds of years, in the village situated near Vijaynagar.
questions.solution:
The Hampi Dance Utsav (or Vijaya Utsav) is organized by the Government of Karnataka at the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hampi.
  • The festival celebrates the grandeur of the Vijayanagara Empire with performances staged against the backdrop of historic ruins.
  • It includes processions, puppet shows, and performances by renowned classical artists.

questions.question: Who among the following received Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contribution to tribal dance Baiga?
questions.solution:
Arjun Singh Dhurwey was honored with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contribution to the Baiga tribal dance.
  • The Baiga is a tribal group from Madhya Pradesh known for their Pardhauni and Karma dances.
  • Dhurwey is credited with popularizing Baiga folk art on national and international platforms.

questions.question: The actor’s performance in a ___________ plays is completely speechless, the story is enacted using a vocabulary of facial expressions and hand-gestures.
questions.solution:
In Kathakali, the performance is traditionally speechless; the story is told entirely through Mudras (hand gestures) and Abhinaya (facial expressions).
  • The dancers use their eyes, eyebrows, and cheeks to convey complex emotions and dialogues.
  • The stories are usually accompanied by a vocalist and percussionists who provide the narrative background.

questions.question: Which of the following Indian Classical dancers was the youngest to receive the Padma Bhushan?
questions.solution:
Sonal Mansingh is the youngest ever Indian classical dancer to be honored with the Padma Bhushan (at age 48 in 1992).
  • She is also the first woman dancer in India to be awarded the Padma Vibhushan (2003).
  • She is a master of Odissi and Bharatanatyam.

questions.question: Which Indian dancer won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for Manipuri Dance in 2018?
questions.solution:
Akham Lakshmi Devi won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018 for her excellence in Manipuri Dance.
  • She is recognized for her dedication to preserving the traditional forms of Manipuri Raas and Sankirtana.

questions.question: Which of the following is a dance form of Assam?
questions.solution:
Bihu is the primary folk dance of Assam.
  • It is performed during the Bohag Bihu (Spring Festival), marking the beginning of the Assamese New Year.
  • The dance is a symbol of the fertility of the land and the youthful energy of the community.
